Canine praziquantel 170 mg ceiling enforced; weights whose lower range exceeds ceiling require product-table review. Canine pyrantel 5 mg/kg corresponds to Nemex-2 base-dose label; MSD small-dog 10 mg/kg is a distinct alternative, not a universal correction. Credelio dog source and food instruction corrected.
